optimization: Cache consecutive descend() into the same plain JSON-Schema sub-document to avoid rebuilding a fresh Validator (and sub-resource resolver) for every array element

upstream_tests.command: cd jsonschema && python3 -m pytest jsonschema/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider

workload.description: Validate a JSON array of N human-readable API-style member records against a fixed Draft 2020-12 schema with nested properties/roles/required/type checks.

benchmark.seed: deterministic; instance members built linearly (index i), no randomness
benchmark.timing: time.perf_counter(), 7 samples per scale, 3 warmup rounds
